[[The Rapture]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[staff]] dropped by [[Charming Peacekeeper]]s and [[White Mantle Sycophant]]s, mercenaries of the [[White Mantle]] who can be found in [[Kryta]] during the [[War in Kryta]].

==Stats==
:[[Energy]] +10
:[[Chaos damage]] 11-22 (Requires 9 [[Fast Casting]])
:Halves skill recharge of [[spell]]s (Chance: 20%)
:Halves casting time of spells (Chance: 10%)
:[[Energy]] +5 
:[[Health]] +30

==Skin==
This item has the [[Astral Staff]] skin.

==Replica==
Except for visual appearance, it is possible to create a technical replica of this item with:
*One of the following [[Fast Casting]] [[staves]]:
**[[Staff]] from crafters [[Asa]], [[Bolereh]], [[Derrick]], [[Rahmdah]], [[Sende]], or [[Soros]]
**[[Asuran Staff]] from crafter [[Nojj]]
**[[Balthazar's Staff]] from collector [[Zaishen Mesmeric Weapon Master]]
**[[Deldrimor Staff]] from crafter [[Grand Mason Stonecleaver]]
**[[Norn Staff]] from crafter [[Keti]]
**[[Oppressor's Staff]] from collector [[Lionguard (collector)|Lionguard]]
**[[Raven Staff]] from crafter [[Hulen Hairyback]]
**[[Staff of Purity]] from collector [[Iza Yoi]]
*[[Perfect]] [[Insightful]] [[Staff Head]].
*[[Perfect]] [[Staff Wrapping]] [[of Fortitude]]
*[[Perfect]] "[[Don't Think Twice]]" inscription

==Unique counterparts==
[[Illyana's Staff]] has stats nearly identical to this item; however, it requires [[Domination]].

==Notes==
*This weapon's skin is normally unable to have a Fast Casting requirement.
